excerpt.zh: 下方星球上的自然保护区提供穿越其外星荒野的导览服务。乘客们可以从导览步道上近距离观赏外星动物群。
excerpt.en: A nature reserve on the planet below offers guided tours through its alien wilderness. Passengers will observe alien fauna from guided walkways.
